sourceOfTruth: Main branch 2026 coverage and prior evidence plus frozen 989 gallery, with seven independent 10 November new artwork-object leads; curatorial proposal only
boundaries: 106 dates previously flagged 'research leads' do have named works: some use titleAsSource/titleAsCatalogued rather than title. Old naive field counts are invalid.
The 25 dates with no original leads are separately screened against the frozen 989 gallery: 15 possible title leads and 10 real candidate gaps.
Source-level ACCEPTED / APPROVED_LOCKED is an artwork-level historical label and NOT proof this Class III date is owner-approved.
A gallery 989 match is lexical title research and not visually verified; Commons-only files not handpicked by owner do not enter curated photo pool automatically.
The exact saint identity rules must be retained, especially Anthony Abbot/Padua; William Montevergine/Aquitaine; Peter Celestine/Apostle; Pope Martin I/Martin Tours; Sylvester Abbot/Pope.
Do not reuse Prado photographs, pay rights fees, contact museums, or restore user-rejected images.
No changes to 1962 proper, existing Class I/II art, Prayer covers, Rosary stages, Calendar runtime or deployment.

Seven newly identified source objects are recorded with source URLs but no photograph acquisition, new Commons eligibility, ownership approval, or Calendar binding. Two represent partial multi-saint feast groups only.
